Apple___Apple_scab.cause: Caused by a fungus that spreads in cool and wet conditions.
Apple___Apple_scab.effect: Dark, rough spots appear on leaves and fruits. Leaves may fall early. Fruits become damaged and less marketable.
Apple___Apple_scab.prevention: Remove infected leaves regularly. Use resistant varieties. Apply fungicide during wet seasons.

Apple___Black_rot.cause: Fungal infection that spreads through infected plant parts and moisture.
Apple___Black_rot.effect: Leaves develop purple spots. Fruits rot and turn black. Branches may also get infected over time.
Apple___Black_rot.prevention: Prune and destroy infected parts. Keep the area clean. Use proper fungicide sprays.

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.cause: Fungus that spreads between apple and nearby cedar trees.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.effect: Yellow-orange spots appear on leaves. It reduces photosynthesis and weakens the plant.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.prevention: Remove nearby cedar trees if possible. Use resistant varieties. Apply fungicide in early stages.

Apple___healthy.effect: Plant is healthy with green leaves and normal growth.
Apple___healthy.prevention: Maintain proper watering, sunlight, and regular monitoring.

Blueberry___healthy.effect: Healthy plant with proper fruit development.
Blueberry___healthy.prevention: Ensure acidic soil, proper watering, and sunlight.

Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.cause: Fungal infection in humid and dry conditions.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.effect: White powder forms on leaves. Leaves curl and growth slows down.
Cherry_(including_sour)___Powdery_mildew.prevention: Improve air circulation. Avoid overcrowding. Use fungicide if needed.

Cherry_(including_sour)___healthy.effect: Healthy leaves and proper fruit growth.

Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.cause: Fungus that spreads in warm and humid environments.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.effect: Gray or brown spots appear on leaves. Photosynthesis reduces, affecting yield.
Corn_(maize)___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray.prevention: Use resistant seeds. Rotate crops. Apply fungicide if severe.

Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.effect: Small brown pustules appear on leaves. Severe cases reduce plant growth.
Corn_(maize)___Common_rust_.prevention: Plant resistant varieties. Monitor early and apply fungicide if needed.

Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.cause: Fungal infection in cool and wet conditions.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.effect: Long gray lesions form on leaves. It reduces leaf area and yield.
Corn_(maize)___Northern_Leaf_Blight.prevention: Use resistant hybrids. Practice crop rotation. Apply fungicide.

Corn_(maize)___healthy.prevention: Maintain soil fertility and proper irrigation.

Grape___Black_rot.cause: Fungus spreads through rain and infected plant parts.
Grape___Black_rot.effect: Black spots appear on leaves. Fruits shrivel and rot completely.
Grape___Black_rot.prevention: Remove infected parts. Improve air circulation. Use fungicide sprays.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).cause: Complex fungal infection affecting the vascular system.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).effect: Leaves show dark patches. Fruits dry and plant weakens over time.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).prevention: Prune infected wood. Avoid wounds. Maintain vineyard hygiene.

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.cause: Fungal infection due to high humidity.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.effect: Brown spots appear on leaves. Leaves may dry and fall early.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.prevention: Remove infected leaves. Improve airflow. Apply fungicide.

Grape___healthy.effect: Healthy vines with good fruit yield.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).effect: Leaves turn yellow unevenly. Fruits are small, bitter, and misshaped.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).prevention: Control insect vectors. Remove infected trees. Use disease-free plants.

Peach___Bacterial_spot.cause: Bacterial infection spread by water splash and wind.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.effect: Dark spots on leaves and fruits. Leaves may fall early.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use resistant varieties. Avoid overhead watering. Apply bactericides.

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.cause: Bacteria spread through water and infected seeds.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.effect: Water-soaked spots appear on leaves and fruits. Growth reduces.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use clean seeds. Avoid overhead watering. Maintain spacing.

Potato___Early_blight.cause: Fungal infection in warm and humid conditions.
Potato___Early_blight.effect: Brown spots with rings appear on leaves. Leaves dry and fall.
Potato___Early_blight.prevention: Use healthy seeds. Remove infected leaves. Apply fungicide.

Potato___Late_blight.cause: Fungus thrives in cool and wet weather.
Potato___Late_blight.effect: Leaves rot quickly. Plant may die rapidly if untreated.
Potato___Late_blight.prevention: Avoid excess moisture. Ensure good drainage. Use fungicide.

Potato___healthy.effect: Healthy plant with good tuber development.

Squash___Powdery_mildew.cause: Fungal infection in dry and humid conditions.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.effect: White powder appears on leaves. Leaves dry and reduce growth.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.prevention: Ensure airflow. Avoid overcrowding. Use fungicide.

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.effect: Leaves turn red or brown and dry. Plant becomes weak.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.prevention: Remove infected leaves. Improve drainage. Use fungicide.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.cause: Bacteria spread through water splash and tools.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.effect: Small dark spots appear on leaves and fruits. Leaves may drop.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Use clean seeds. Avoid wetting leaves. Apply bactericide.

Tomato___Early_blight.effect: Brown spots with rings appear on leaves. Lower leaves die first.
Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Remove infected leaves. Use fungicide. Rotate crops.

Tomato___Late_blight.cause: Fungus spreads in cool and wet conditions.
Tomato___Late_blight.effect: Leaves turn brown quickly and rot. Fruits also get infected.
Tomato___Late_blight.prevention: Avoid excess moisture. Improve airflow. Use fungicide.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.effect: Yellow spots on top and mold below leaves. Reduces plant growth.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.prevention: Reduce humidity. Improve ventilation. Use fungicide.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.effect: Small gray spots with dark edges appear. Leaves fall early.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.prevention: Remove infected leaves. Avoid overhead watering.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.cause: Tiny insects feeding on leaf sap.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.effect: Leaves turn yellow and dry. Webbing may appear.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.prevention: Spray water or insecticide. Keep plants hydrated.

Tomato___Target_Spot.effect: Dark circular spots with rings appear. Leaves weaken.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.effect: Leaves curl and turn yellow. Plant growth is stunted.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.cause: Virus spread through contact and tools.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.effect: Leaves show mixed green patterns. Growth is reduced.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.prevention: Use clean tools. Avoid handling infected plants.
